title: Memory is distributed
technology: Donghua collections, municipal archives, platforms and brand records
governingQuestion: What survives when fashion memory is split across institutions and commercial platforms?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: Memory is distributed
longform.opening: Shanghai fashion memory has no single vault: it is distributed among universities, civic archives, organizers, platforms and brands.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Donghua University’s textile-and-costume museum and the Shanghai Municipal Archives expose different institutional routes into material and civic memory.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Organizer news, university collections, archives, scholarship databases and commercial platforms preserve different fragments under different access and reuse rules.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No complete public archive was located that preserves every Shanghai show’s invitations, worker credits, venue plans, source files, rights, platform metrics and commercial outcomes.

longform.closing: Shanghai Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
